Client-sent X-Forwarded-Host/-For/-Proto and Forwarded are still forwarded as client headers ahead of the proxy's X-Forwarded-Host; dropping them is SEC-PROXY-002 (wave-19). With no Host, a client X-Forwarded-Host would reach the backend, conflicting with FR-PROXY-004 AC-4 until wave-19 lands.

D-050 earlier steps (WebSocket pass-through, method token 400, CONNECT/TRACE 405) are not implemented; the path check is currently first in Proxy.handle. Under stripPrefix(true) a WebSocket upgrade to an app.ws route is forwarded unstripped (plain path) or 400 (encoded); FR-PROXY-009 removes that path.
Test helpers (ConnectionCounter, exchange, tinyHttpdProxy) are copied across proxy test classes; a shared test-support class needs files outside this lease.

srs_deltas.proposal: On TinyHttpd with default ServerOptions an absolute-form target naming a non-allowlisted host gets 421 (HostAllowlistFilter) before middleware; allow '400 or 421 or forwarded only to the configured target', or state the host is allowlisted.

Record the host-name grammar settled in implementation: dot-separated labels of 1..63 ASCII letters/digits/'-'/'_', each with a letter or digit, no leading/trailing '-', at most 253 characters, one optional trailing root dot; names like '.', '-', 'a..b', '_' throw IllegalArgumentException.
State that a Host line whose value is empty after OWS counts as no Host.

State that under stripPrefix(true) a request to exactly the mount path forwards the base path + '/' + raw query (/api/orders?x=1 -> /base/?x=1), and that a stripped remainder that is not a raw suffix of the checked originalUrl() answers 400 before any backend connection.
